hook: A missed call is a missed job
problem: Most people who hit voicemail don't leave a message. They call the next shop.

steps.small: Most business phone apps have it built in
Short, human, with a real name
So they reply instead of calling someone else

example: Sorry we missed your call. This is [your name] at [your shop]. What's going on?

cta.line1: Get one free tip like this every week
